The shipment arrived on time, _____ several items were missing from the order.
Please submit the form today, _____ your application may not be considered.
Or introduces a consequence or alternative: submit it, or this may happen.
The report was detailed, _____ it was easy for the board to follow.
So introduces the result of the first clause.
The manager did not attend the seminar, _____ did she send a representative.
Use nor with subject-auxiliary inversion to add a second negative idea.
The sales figures improved, _____ the marketing budget remained unchanged.
The office will remain closed on Monday, _____ the building is undergoing electrical repairs.
Here, for is a coordinating conjunction meaning because.
The company offers flexible hours _____ remote-work options to eligible employees.
And adds a second item to the list.
You may contact the service desk by phone, _____ you can submit a request online.
The manager did not authorize the purchase, _____ did she approve the reimbursement.
After a negative clause, nor introduces another negative clause and requires inversion.
The meeting ran longer than expected, _____ the next session had to be rescheduled.
So shows that rescheduling was the result.
The supplier promised a discount, _____ the final invoice included the original price.
But marks the contrast between the promise and what happened.
The instructions were brief _____ clear enough for every participant to follow.
The new policy is neither complicated _____ expensive to implement.
The correlative pair neither ... nor connects two negative alternatives.
The company has not selected a contractor, _____ has it approved the project timeline.
Use nor to add a second negative statement, with inversion.
The printer is out of service, _____ the report must be sent from another department.
So introduces the consequence of the printer being unavailable.
The training session was optional, _____ nearly every employee chose to attend.
_____ the proposal was more expensive, the board approved it because of its long-term benefits.
Although introduces a concession: the cost was high, but approval was given.
The supplier received the contract _____ its quotation was the most competitive.
Because introduces the reason the supplier received the contract.
Employees must wear safety glasses _____ they enter the production area.
Whenever means every time that event occurs.
The payment will not be released _____ the finance director authorizes it.
Until marks the point at which the payment can be released.
The company will extend the warranty _____ the customer registers the product within 30 days.
Provided that means on the condition that.
Please keep a copy of the receipt _____ you need to request a refund.
In case introduces a precaution for a possible future situation.
_____ the new system is faster, it requires less maintenance than the old one.
Now that introduces a present circumstance that explains the result.
The documents must be signed _____ the shipment can be released.
Before establishes that signing must happen first.
The company reduced its travel expenses, _____ its investment in staff training increased.
The technician will contact you _____ the replacement part arrives.
As soon as means immediately after a specified event.
The project will continue _____ additional funding is approved.
If introduces the condition required for the project to continue.
The manager spoke slowly _____ everyone could take accurate notes.
So that introduces purpose; the slower speech made note-taking possible.
_____ the audit was completed, the accounting team archived the supporting documents.
After establishes the sequence: the audit finished first.
The company will not reimburse the expense _____ it is supported by an original receipt.
Unless means if ... not; a receipt is required for reimbursement.
_____ the first branch specializes in corporate accounts, the second focuses on individual customers.
While can contrast two facts or situations.
The shipment was delayed _____ severe weather affected the port.
Because introduces the cause of the delay.
The revised contract will take effect _____ both parties have signed it.
Once means as soon as or after the condition has been completed.
_____ the deadline was approaching, the team requested an extension.
Since introduces a reason here: the deadline was approaching.
The orientation is designed for _____ new employees _____ temporary staff.
The correlative pair both ... and includes two groups.
Applicants may submit _____ a printed form _____ an online application.
The updated software is _____ easier to use _____ more secure than the previous version.
Not only ... but also adds a second, reinforcing point.
The delay was caused by _____ the weather _____ a shortage of drivers.
The committee has not decided _____ to renew the lease _____ to relocate the office.
Whether ... or introduces two alternatives under consideration.
The new policy affects _____ the sales department _____ the customer service team.
The replacement is _____ available locally _____ affordable to import.
Neither ... nor shows that neither condition is true.
The company will provide _____ a full refund _____ a replacement product, depending on the customer’s preference.
The new director is respected _____ for her experience _____ for her willingness to mentor junior staff.
The structure not only ... but also coordinates two reasons.
The company must decide _____ to renew the contract _____ to negotiate different terms.
Use whether ... or when presenting alternatives to be decided.
_____ the sales team _____ the logistics department has access to the restricted file; authorization is limited to managers.
The singular verb has agrees with the nearer singular subject, department, after neither ... nor.
The conference will feature _____ international speakers _____ practical workshops.
Both ... and links two elements included in the conference.
The new schedule is _____ convenient for staff _____ cost-effective for the company.
Neither ... nor states that neither quality applies.
The report explains _____ how the error occurred _____ how the department corrected it.
Not only ... but also adds a second related point.
You must confirm _____ the morning session _____ the afternoon session when registering.
Either ... or indicates that one of the two sessions must be selected.
The decision depends on _____ the supplier can meet the deadline _____ the client can accept a later delivery.
